- The Carinthian Coat of Arms celebrates Lam Research’s lasting impact on innovation, talent development, economic growth, and semiconductor technology, both in Austria and around the world.


Lam Research has received the right to bear the Carinthian Coat of Arms. The recognition marks a significant milestone for the company and highlights the role Villach has played in advancing semiconductor innovation for four decades.


The award was presented during a celebration at Lam's development and manufacturing site in Villach, attended by Austrian and regional leaders, including Federal Chancellor Christian Stocker, Governor Daniel Fellner, State Councillor Sebastian Schuschnig, and Villach Mayor Günther Albel.


### **A Recognition of Long-Term Impact**


The Carinthian Coat of Arms is among the highest distinctions granted by the State of Carinthia. It recognizes organizations that have made meaningful contributions to the region through innovation, economic development, education, sustainability, and community engagement.


For Lam, the honor reflects decades of investment in talent, technology, and manufacturing excellence. Over the years, the company’s Villach team has helped shape Carinthia into a globally recognized center for semiconductor expertise, supporting customers around the world while creating opportunities within the local community.


"Lam Research emphasizes two powerful ideas: togetherness and progress,” says Governor Daniel Fellner. “Those are the foundations of future success. As Governor of Carinthia, I extend my heartfelt congratulations on this milestone. As State Councillor responsible for technology, I am proud that such an outstanding company—one that enables many of the world’s leading semiconductor manufacturers—calls Carinthia home.”


### **From Austrian Startup to Global Semiconductor Leadership**


Lam’s history in Austria began in 1986 with the founding of SEZ, a pioneer in single-wafer cleaning technology. Following Lam Research’s acquisition of SEZ in 2008, the company’s Austrian operations continued to grow and expand.


Today, Villach serves as Lam’s global center of expertise for clean and wet processing technologies. These capabilities are essential for enabling semiconductor manufacturers to build increasingly sophisticated devices used in artificial intelligence, high-performance computing, and next-generation digital infrastructure.


The company’s Austrian footprint now extends beyond Villach to Salzburg, home to Lam’s[Panel-Level Packaging Center of Excellence](https://newsroom.lamresearch.com/wafer-to-panel-lam-scaling-advanced-packaging-panel-level-processing?blog=true) . Together, these locations contribute to the development of technologies that support semiconductor manufacturing worldwide.


### **Supporting the Next Generation of Semiconductors**


Demand for AI-driven applications is increasing the manufacturing challenges faced by chipmakers. Producing advanced semiconductors requires extraordinary levels of precision, process control, and reliability.


Technologies developed in Villach play an important role in meeting those challenges. Advanced cleaning and surface preparation solutions help semiconductor manufacturers achieve the performance and yield requirements necessary for leading-edge devices.


"As Rapidus works toward the challenging goal of advanced logic semiconductors, beginning with the 2-nanometer generation, we deeply value Lam's commitment to innovation, quality, and collaboration,” says Yasumitsu Orii, Ph.D., senior managing executive officer, Head of Chiplet Solutions Division, Rapidus Corporation. “Technologies developed and manufactured in Villach represent some of Austria's most significant contributions to the global semiconductor ecosystem and play an important role in enabling the next generation of semiconductors — including advanced logic and packaging, AI, and future applications that will shape our industry and society."


### **A Milestone Built on People and Partnership**


For Lam, the 40-year anniversary is ultimately a celebration of the people who have driven innovation in Austria across four decades. Employees in Villach have helped solve some of the industry’s most complex manufacturing challenges while building lasting partnerships with customers, educational institutions, government leaders, and the local community.


The Carinthian Coat of Arms joins another significant recognition received in recent years. In 2024, the[City of Villach granted Lam the right to bear the Villach Coat of Arms](https://newsroom.lamresearch.com/Lam-Research-Is-Honored-with-Villach,-Austrias-Coat-of-Arms?blog=true) in recognition of the company’s contributions to the community and local economy.


Together, these honors reflect the strong relationship between Lam and the region it has called home for 40 years.


### **Looking Ahead**


As semiconductor technologies continue to advance, the importance of innovation in manufacturing will only increase. With four decades of expertise in Villach and a continued commitment to research, development, and collaboration, Lam remains well positioned to help shape the future of the semiconductor industry while contributing to the continued growth of Austria's technology ecosystem.
